title: jmap-server Session: i18n capability and preferredLanguages account capability (null for non-owned accounts)
description:
jmap-server Session: advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n ({}) only on opt-in, and the account capability with `preferredLanguages`.
- Add a backend hook returning Option<Vec<LanguageTag>> per account. How it is set is the deployment's business.
- The hook MUST return null (None) for accounts the requesting user does not own (draft Privacy Considerations, SHOULD; we enforce it in the helper so backends can't leak).
- Document in rustdoc: a server MAY use preferredLanguages for text written with no request in progress (push text). It MUST NOT use it to change /get or /query results.
notes:
Design: docs/design/updates.md (final 2026-11-15, decisions 27-31). Account capability comes from i18n_info; preferred_languages None for accounts the caller does not own (draft §9).
2026-11-15: preferredLanguages was DROPPED from draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 (working copy in jmap-chat-spec). The account value of urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n is now {} like the Session value; the Account Language Preference section is gone (left to a future JMAP account-settings spec). Remove preferredLanguages from scope here.
